propositions: T15 eval fixture must cover applicable/pass cases that name boot, authentication, authorization, connectivity, readiness risks with concrete proof and scoped cleanup.
T15 eval fixture must cover applicable/finding cases with slow delivery-loop feedback, destructive table-drop cleanup, and shared-bucket wipe scenarios.
T15 eval fixture must cover not-applicable/pass cases for app-only, library-only, CLI-only, docs-only, health-route, and S2/S3 pipeline/unit-test boundaries.
Packaged T15 spec must validate offline with strict schema, registered deterministic scorers, balanced dataset, and non-empty gold set via rebar prompt eval command.
Unit tests must pin T15 case identifiers, labels, applicability matrix, scorer discipline, and public spec loader integration.
Observed application-scope false positives must be recorded in the false-positives ledger as regression guards.
